steps.note: S1.3.1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch contents, and S1.3.1's motivation gives the reason that the schedule subtracts the old scratch contributions and finally restores them.

S1.3.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, nonzero only for the self pair and intersection one, with the side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, as at 752-755.
S1.3.1.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with its values per intersection size and the side injection cancelling intersections zero and two.
S1.3.2 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) via forward, inverse, forward invocations, each restoring its own scratch wires.

S1.5.5 states that every edge joins comparable labels and its sub-steps reproduce every row of the residual table with matching residuals and dimensions, derived by splitting A=B perp P and F=<t> perp t^perp.

S1.5.5.14 gives the side 2->5 residual P tensor <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 and grounds it in t_X perp t_Y; the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp is left implicit in 'possible because', which is a faithful compression.
The plan states that center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, losing h, with source sum N, sink sum Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N, and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich.

S1.5.5.19 states that over F_2 every nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating and so has an orthonormal basis; the absorption of alternating planes (the paper's 'for completeness' paragraph) is not spelled out.
S1.5.6 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly.
S2.1.1 states that orthogonal binary vectors have even support intersection, so weight is additive mod 4, giving q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal residual basis of wt(v)[v.x].

S2.1.2 states the odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} and its two-term expansion, and that Hadamard conjugation turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse; the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X is carried by 'conjugating by Hadamard matrices'.

The plan states one translation kernel per residual basis vector (S1.5.9) and that each yields one child call on the f axes, i.e. columns, of a slot, s_c in all (S2.1.6, S2.1.7, matching paper 1878-1906), which is the k-column tensoring in the paper's applied notation.

S2.1.3 quotes the zero/full label frames (line 1287) and states the source and sink corrections C=iZC^{-1}Z on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) and the undoing of the signed exchange; it compresses the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} factors and the negation of the X outputs into those phrases.
S1.5.6 states that both ratios are below 1/2, and S1.5.7 and S1.5.9 give s<Wm with deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 (checked against 1151 and 1222).
S1.5.10 states eta_b=339/22587335000000 exactly.
S1.5.10 states eta_c=73/19906842167500 exactly.
S1.5.10.1-3 state that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, that log m<20, the chain m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), and hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.
S1.6.1-3 give the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations, repeating on the active indices, and exactly a ones in Pi.
S1.7.1 states a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators of the finite factor table, keeping the factors invertible modulo q^b.
S1.7.2 states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order with controlled shifts.
S1.7.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, sending (h,d) to (h+d,d) with one interchange each, a in all.
S2.4.1 and S2.4 give E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3}=20 with nu=11, C_0=128mB^2 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}).
S2.4.3 states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf, and S2.4.2 bounds the per-invocation count below E via 24W^3+4s+4W+4<E.
S2.4.4 unrolls with sx+E<=Bx and B^{log_m d}<=d^nu to A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and S2.4.5 bounds the total below 128mB^2 d^{nu+3}<=C_0 d^{C_1}.
S2.4.6 states that depth-l values lie in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l, so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits suffice, and S2.4.7 gives eps*C_1<1, hence Delta=o(p).
S2.5 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so coefficients stay in the disk, and that truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^{-p}.

summary: P01 states all 26 sub-steps with their defining content and none contrary to the paper. The most compressed are L2 (the inclusion is implicit in 'because t_X perp t_Y'), L4 (absorption of alternating planes not spelled out), P3 (stated in the layer's f-axis form rather than at 1262-1271) and P4 (the Z_{a,k}/i^{27k} repair and the X-output negation summarised as source/sink corrections with C=iZC^{-1}Z and undoing the signed exchange).
